camel_example: aliyun esa CreateWaitingRoomRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --RuleEnable on --Rule 'http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg' --WaitingRoomId 25133f536f1b1f6b6091f6a92c614dd4 --RuleName waitingroom_example
description_en: Creates a waiting room bypass rule
description_zh: 创建一个等候室绕过规则
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-waiting-room-rule --site-id 1234560000 --waiting-room-id 25133f536f1b1f6b6091f6a92c614dd4 --rule-name waitingroom_example --rule-enable on --rule http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWaitingRoomRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the waiting room to bypass
parameters.name: waiting_room_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. Use a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

For the complete syntax of rule expressions, refer to <props="china">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

规则表达式完整语法参考<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
parameters.name: rule
